Deadlines and Events
Deadlines and Events
Request Information Apply Now
The Ph.D. in Data Science has one annual cycle, starting in the fall term. Each fall, we host program open houses and Q&A sessions about the program's curriculum, research opportunities, application process, and what it means to get a Ph.D. in Data Science.
Register for an Upcoming Event
The following deadlines are for Fall 2027 admission:
Application Opens
Saturday, Aug. 15, 2026
Application Deadline
Friday, Jan. 8, 2027 (11:59 pm ET)
Applicants have a one-week grace period to submit transcripts, English language test scores (if required) and letter(s) of recommendation. Note that we do not accept research papers, articles, statements of purpose, GRE scores, or other supplementary items aside those required for the application.
Ph.D. Virtual Interview Days
Week of Feb. 8, 2027
The School of Data Science will invite selected candidates to connect with current and other prospective Ph.D. students, learn about faculty research and our data science community, and to engage in round-robin admission interviews with Data Science faculty.
Applications are still under review during Interview Days, and not every student under consideration for admission will be invited to interview days, as we have limited spots available.
Decisions Released
Friday, March 5, 2027 (12 p.m. ET)
Admitted Ph.D. Students Days
Friday, March 19, 2027 (Travel-day March 18)
Admitted students will be invited to the University of Virginia to get to know us better.
Response to Offer Deadline
Thursday, April 15, 2027 (11:59 p.m. ET)
